name: Tactile terrain / soft ground and clear intention
art: The original terrain is site/assets/motion/terrain-interface.webp. Background and masked foreground share that image's crop. Keep its fiber quality and lighting coherent if replacing it.

properties.label: Choice rail, product frame and terrain
properties.text: On a warm light feature surface, place a concise heading and three-item choice rail at left, a considered miniature collection interface at right and rich coral terrain across the foreground. Let terrain overlap only the nonessential base of the product frame.

properties.label: Coral suede-fiber terrain
properties.text: Build coral-orange hills from fine suede-like fibers, uneven crests, self-shadowed folds and warm light. Contrast their granular softness with precise interface planes; a flat orange curve is not equivalent.

properties.label: Cream, charcoal and coral
properties.text: Use cream and white-to-ivory interface planes, warm charcoal ink and coral-orange terrain, with a small tactile mark that echoes the foreground color.

properties.label: Precise layered collection preview
properties.text: Create a legible original miniature collection interface with quiet rules, tabular details, layered window edges and meaningful surface specimens rather than copied customer data.

properties.label: Choices update a visible preview
properties.text: Each feature choice updates the collection title, message and visual surface specimens, with a stable active rail marker. Keep operation available to keyboard and touch, and recompose preview and terrain independently on phones.

properties.label: Terrain occlusion and fiber check
properties.text: The foreground must not hide essential controls or the selected outcome. Compare fiber detail and contact relationships close up, and confirm the miniature UI remains legible.
